verdict.rationale: Appwrite's self-hosting model, per-project CLI targeting (--endpoint flag), and non-interactive CLI support make it possible to stand up an isolated project/instance for testing separate from production, and migration tooling suggests moving data between environments. However, there's no explicitly documented 'sandbox' or staging-environment feature, seeded test data, or environment-cloning workflow purpose-built for AI-native testing. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/staging environment feature, test-data seeding or project-cloning tools, explicit documentation framing isolated testing for AI agents.
